item.title: Dangerous Footpath Conditions Causing Injury to a Pedestrian, 11th October
item.description:
Loose and uneven paving slabs on the footpath pose a serious trip hazard. Overgrown greenery obstructs light, making the uneven surface difficult for pedestrians to see, particularly in poor lighting. My wife recently tripped and fell, injuring her knees and palms, which resulted in significant bleeding, swelling and considerable pain. Please urgently repair the loose slabs and cut back the overgrown greenery to improve visibility and prevent further injuries.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tyers Terrace, Vauxhall, Greater London
